    -- plus the sum over `j = 1 … k+1`.  Re‑index the latter sum
    -- by `i = j-1`.  Apply Pascal's identity
    -- `choose (k+1+i+1) (i+1) = choose (k+i+1) i + choose (k+i+1) (i+1)`.
